title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Pink Lemonade
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Keep your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K device flowing with flavour with the Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus a 10ml refill container, together delivering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent flavour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod and refill system offers a simple and reliable way to enjoy vaping with the Dojo Blast kit, supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology. Pink Lemonade delivers the ultimate summer refreshment with a balance of sweet and sharp notes. The blend leads with the juicy, berry sweetness of Raspberry, which is perfectly cut by a zesty, sparkling Lemonade base. The result is a vibrant and bubbly tasting vape that captures the classic character of the popular soft drink. With transparent pods and a clean refill system, managing e-liquid levels is straightforward and fuss-free.
